items.semantic_assessment: Static corpus membership evolves into a runtime agent-memory privacy unit with memory revision, access mode, query family and correlated-probe ownership; audit cost, false positives, scratch-memory fallback and exact disclosed-attack limits are explicit.

Immutable shared weights evolve into request-owned mutable TTT state with owner, version, phase and read/write effects; copy-on-write cost, contamination failure, immutable-decode fallback and exact TTT scope are explicit.

Fully replicated data-parallel weights evolve into an intra-node layer-owner pool using WaS for large batches and CaS for small tails; fabric and synchronization costs, owner failure, DP fallback and disclosed offline-workload limits are explicit.

The current-response prompt-injection boundary evolves into persistent-state provenance and write/read/use-time revalidation; metadata cost, false rejects, stateless read-only fallback and disclosed persistence-path limits are explicit.

Fixed roles and topology evolve into versioned proposals checked against capability, communication, validation, aggregation and output contracts before atomic commit; evaluator cost, coverage failure and prior-topology fallback are explicit.

Ordinary typed tool calls evolve into recursive program holes whose whole action graph is checked against types and capabilities before effects; checker and sandbox costs, well-typed-but-wrong failure and short typed-call fallback are explicit.

Output-side watermark statistics evolve into an attested PRNG, seed and sampling supply chain; key-management cost, public-seed failure, signed-metadata fallback for high-risk use and exact seed-layer attack limits are explicit.

A precision label evolves into an execution artifact that also owns reduction topology and bounded-ULP activation implementation; reproducibility cost, nondeterminism limits and fast-service versus audit-plan coexistence are explicit.

Backward-graph first-order optimization gains a zeroth-order branch whose optimizer owns perturbation seed, objective, direction and update while serving remains only a forward executor; variance and forward-count costs, first-order fallback and exact disclosed model/task/hardware limits are explicit.

Control metadata moves from agent-readable prompts into an infrastructure-owned out-of-band data, control and evidence envelope verified at every transition; propagation cost, missing-control fail-closed behavior and low-risk simplified-metadata coexistence are explicit.
